changelog: - **The last two public pages a marketing visitor could click through to now speak about the marketing product** (#2475, #2457, epic #2348). `/features` filtered its catalogue by the request vertical's capabilities — the same `caps.includes(f.capability)` expression the landing grid already used — and the still-untagged internship cards (mentee insights, intern projects, project teams and join requests, mentor self-apply, weekly reports, offers, requisitions, interview requests, talent pool, rematch, match quality, dormant check-in, stories, dual role, the career newsletter and the published price list) carry a capability at last; a card that holds for every vertical deliberately carries none, and the rule is written at the top of `src/lib/features.ts`. `/pricing` does NOT get invented marketing prices: every number on it comes from `src/lib/plans.ts` and prices the internship product (the metering unit is the active matched pair), and the marketing packaging has not been decided, so a MARKETING host hides the free core, the plan bands, the meter, the overage, the employer wallet, the add-ons and the four internship CTAs, keeping only the two claims that hold without a price list (self-hosting is free under AGPL-3.0; there is no checkout, a paid plan is invoiced after a conversation) — and the header and footer "Pricing" entries are hidden there rather than promising a price list the page cannot show (#2474 assumed the page would be dressed; one line restores them when prices are published). The public project showcase `/projects` was `{ isPublic: true }` with no scope at all — one deployment listed every tenant's public projects, owner names included — and is now scoped to the request vertical, with the default vertical matching "not another vertical" so legacy projects with no `orgId` stay visible; MARKETING answers 404 because it does not carry the `projects` capability at all (#2473/#2499), rather than an empty grid promising a showcase this product does not have. Anonymous access is unchanged. Also: the `pricing` namespace joined `SERVER_ONLY_NAMESPACES` (its only reader is the server page), and the root layout now applies the vertical overlay BEFORE stripping those namespaces — stripping first merged them straight back in, so a marketing host was shipping the whole marketing `landing` overlay to the browser. Two follow-ups from review: the `messaging` card is core CRM so the capability filter cannot reach it, and its description was the last sentence on the marketing `/features` stating the internship relation model ("per-mentorship threads") — it now reads "a thread per deal" there through the vertical overlay, in all three languages; and the public live-demo card is tagged `mentorship`, because one demo instance exists and it runs the internship product (#2501 already hides its footer link on a marketing host). The root 404 page is vertical-aware too: it offered a Register button that host refuses, the mentor application, the partner-company pitch and a link straight back to `/projects` — the URL that had just answered 404.

en: On the marketing site, the feature catalogue now lists only what the marketing product actually does — no mentors, evaluations, placements or intern projects.
The marketing site says plainly that its pricing is not published yet instead of showing the internship price list, and the project showcase is no longer a mix of both products.
A wrong URL on the marketing site now shows a 404 page that offers only the marketing product's own pages, instead of the mentor application and a sign-up button that site does not accept.
tr: Pazarlama sitesinde özellik kataloğu artık yalnızca pazarlama ürününün gerçekten yaptıklarını listeliyor — mentor, değerlendirme, yerleştirme ve stajyer projeleri yok.
Pazarlama sitesi, staj fiyat listesini göstermek yerine fiyatlandırmasının henüz yayınlanmadığını açıkça söylüyor; proje vitrini de artık iki ürünün karışımı değil.
Pazarlama sitesinde hatalı bir adres artık yalnızca pazarlama ürününün kendi sayfalarını öneren bir 404 sayfası gösteriyor; mentor başvurusu ve o sitenin kabul etmediği kayıt butonu yok.
de: Auf der Marketing-Seite listet der Funktionskatalog jetzt nur noch das, was das Marketing-Produkt wirklich kann — keine Mentor:innen, Bewertungen, Vermittlungen oder Praktikumsprojekte.
Die Marketing-Seite sagt klar, dass ihre Preise noch nicht veröffentlicht sind, statt die Praktikums-Preisliste zu zeigen, und die Projektgalerie mischt die beiden Produkte nicht mehr.

Eine falsche Adresse auf der Marketing-Seite zeigt jetzt eine 404-Seite, die nur noch die eigenen Seiten des Marketing-Produkts anbietet — ohne Mentor-Bewerbung und ohne Registrieren-Button, den diese Seite gar nicht akzeptiert.
